text:
morgan: Quick postmortem note  tenant left on old variant after migration. Root cause: controllers set soft_unbind_at but never wrote lease_expires_ts, router treats missing TTL as infinite.

sam: ouch. so two fields with different semantics. can we standardize?

morgan: propose minimal additive canonical TTL: lease_expires_ts (authoritative). Keep soft_unbind_at as operator hint. Router should fall back to soft_unbind_at + default_grace (1h) but emit a diagnostic counter.

elaine: agree on additive approach. also add pin_state enum (active,migrating,evicted) so router behavior is explicit.

schema-bot: suggested field set (additive): ["pin_state","lease_expires_ts","soft_unbind_at","provenance_tokens","rollout_signal_strength","probe_percentage","transition_id"]. Constraints: provenance tokens <=8 items, each <=64 chars; probe_percentage 0-100.

morgan: runtime behavior: when pin_state==migrating prefer new variant with probability (1 - probe_percentage/100). If lease_expires_ts missing but soft_unbind_at present, set lease_expires_ts = soft_unbind_at + 3600 (default_grace) and increment diagnostic counter missing_ttl.

sam: telemetry: emit pin.lifecycle events (created,migrated,probe_scaled,eviction_scheduled,evicted) with transition_id. Also emit pin.probe samples for debug.

elaine: operational thresholds proposal (conservative):
- compute age_ratio = (now - created_ts) / max(lease_expires_ts - created_ts,1)
- if age_ratio > 1.0 -> alert and set probe_percentage=10
- if age_ratio > 1.5 -> escalate, probe_percentage=30
- if age_ratio > 2.5 -> mark candidate for eviction, notify oncall for 1h review then auto-evict if no objection

morgan: compatibility: keep fields optional. older clients ignore unknown keys. also add provenance_blob string for older stubs while we roll out provenance_tokens array.

sam: tests: add e2e that simulates controllers writing only soft_unbind_at and verify router logs missing_ttl and applies temporary grace. Also fuzz probe scaling with different rollout_signal_strengths. I'll add a harness.

elaine: ops playbook (short):
1) Alert: age_ratio > 1.0 or missing_ttl counter spikes>5/min
2) Set probe_percentage=10 and run smoke checks 15m
3) If errors spike >5% rollback cohort for tenant
4) If smoke OK and age_ratio continues rising, schedule eviction after manual review window

morgan: small implementation note: add an event-store stream pin.lifecycle keyed by pin_id for easier reconstructions.

sam: security: redact any PII in provenance_tokens before shipping to external telemetry. keep full provenance only in internal event-store.

ops-bot: created INF-2028 assigned to @morgan @sam @elaine :thumbsup: will ping #eng-oncall when PR lands for tuning.

morgan: action items: morgan -> PR for schema+router grace; sam -> telemetry + sim harness; elaine -> client-stub compat tests + redact rules. target: next Tue.

elaine: thanks. when PR is up @schema-bot please run the schema linter and drop a note here.

schema-bot: lint OK (fields additive, size limits respected).
